title: Eric DeCosta: Last year was a "lost season" for Rashod Bateman, this year we're excited

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Eric DeCosta: Last year was a "lost season" for Rashod Bateman, this year we're excited
sources.description: "He's a phenomenal athlete. Great route-runner. Rashod, it's right there in front of him. He's shown flashes of being a real problem for other teams," DeCosta said.
